```yaml
name: Claude Review

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  claude-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v2
      with:
        python-version: '3.x'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -r requirements.txt

    - name: Run test plan
      run: |
        # Test case 1: Submit SLURM job with CLI arguments
        python scripts/evaluation_with_nemo_run.py --slurm --account my_account --partition my_partition --job_dir /path/to/job_dir

        # Test case 2: Verify env var fallbacks work
        export ACCOUNT=my_account
        export PARTITION=my_partition
        python scripts/evaluation_with_nemo_run.py --slurm
```
